title: Dimensional changes of peri-implant tissues with connective tissue grafts vs. with xenogenic matrices
authors: Bello CL, Serrano MC. Rev Cubana Estomatol. 2020 Jan;57(1), 56-69.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Increase in the thickness of peri-implant tissues after 90 days was similar in the two study groups” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
